# Purpose 

This script provides example code for tutorial participants to copy and then 
modify, as part of the RStudio GUI GitHub tutorial.


```{r loop_example}

## loop to execute a simple mathematical task of your choice

for(i in 1:10){
  
  x <- i**3 ### your code goes here!
  
  print(x) 
  
}


```
